title: Jennifer Lawrence is breaking into beauty with her own hair care brand Mes°
summary: The American actress, who has starred in hit movies Mother!, Silver Linings Playbook and The Hunger Games franchise, is launching ‘biodesigned hair care’ brand Mes° this month, engineered by biotech beauty company Arcaea
